stemMd: Why does Mr. Vale bring a jar?

options.label: A
options.textMd: He expects his daughter to bring shells that he can put in it.

options.label: B
options.textMd: He is collecting a visitor permit.

options.label: C
options.textMd: He intends to borrow tea from the office.

options.label: D
options.textMd: He plans to organize the office keys.

explanationMd: The closing paragraph directly explains the jar: it is for the shells his daughter always brings. That concrete detail also reveals the personal reason for his wait.

distractorRationale.b: The passage states that he does not want a permit.
distractorRationale.d: He recognizes a key but does not bring the jar for keys.
distractorRationale.c: The jar is explicitly linked to the daughter's shells.
